title: Sagla boolih karmah seeco
intro: Taswiir dubuk soola tide of mockery lih xer waktih imperiyal ugtuma kee raddam, bar kee ayro seeco abak aytiita laqna kee sartan diggalsimta. foocal kafin ardii kee leeh amol xissiime merrayti yan naharal tumbullem hinna. Atu tama arcibah arcibah derret yan sabri cussuttam duuddaa?
clues: Anu inni ummatta bar kee loqoy, uqrat kee qaduuk Yalla akah qibaadinaanah arcibiseh suge.
Yi ummatta feeraari aytit culteeh, yok yadaaroonuh sartan sinnil buulen.
Anu inni ummattah fanat sagla bool kee kontom liggiditteh miraaciinu keenih seecak suge.
Anu Yallih intiitaa kee wahyu gubat merraytu xiseh yi ummatta kafin baaxol yoo anqasak sugte wak.
Anu kulli qaynatih nammay takkoh quukah amriseh sugem kee mu'miniin amri yemeete wak kee mididdi kibbiimeh yan waqdi.
anu ubleh mooyat qaleela innah ugte wak weeqi cineh yan mara culse wak, Yalli doonik addat yan mara cateh.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Casbi addat suge way amoyti soono maqniseh
950 liggiditteh yi ummattah bar kee loqo seece
manol beeniih fayyale guddaaqa fan ugte
Baddi addat yan kaxxa kullumti yanxuqeh suge.
trial.answer: 950 liggiditteh yi ummattah bar kee loqo seece

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Yi ummatta malcina bar xabcin silaytut finqitteh sugte
Cinne mari kaxxa weeqi addat culeeh, mu'miniin cattiimeh.
Yi ummatta finqitteh caylale bakaq inki saaku
Yi ummatta damaaqe fan milaagimte umaaneh
Yi ummatta kaxxiinak ardi yonxuqeh suge.
outcome.answer: Cinne mari kaxxa weeqi addat culeeh, mu'miniin cattiimeh.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
